title: Make agent setup MCP-first and avoid repeated onboard calls
description: Update AGENTS.md and generated onboarding so agents use the configured Plantool MCP server when available, and use the CLI briefing only as a fallback. Do not ask each future session to rerun onboarding.
why: The current generated onboarding asks agents to add a note that tells future sessions to run plantool agent onboard, which can cause repeated startup work. MCP already provides concise server instructions and an on-demand guide.

acceptance.text: AGENTS.md gives MCP-first guidance with a CLI fallback
Generated onboarding no longer asks agents to rerun onboard in every new agent context
MCP setup requirement and fallback are clear

outcome.summary: Made the repository guidance MCP-first with a CLI fallback and stopped generated onboarding from asking each future session to rerun the briefing.
